requirements.why_still_valid: The accepted meal-pattern snapshot boundary is unchanged by A3/B2/DC4 rerun. The test parametrically proves representative 1/2/3/5/6-opportunity schedules and ran in the exact-head full backend regression.
The product boundary remains six accepted opportunities; seven must fail closed. The domain bytes are unchanged and the test ran on the exact verification freeze.

These application tests prove accepted PROGRAM/CUSTOM meal-pattern expansion/versioning and persisted shared-event Servings. A3 changes recipe revisions and B2 changes Planner ordering only; the meal-pattern persistence contract itself was not changed.

Planner consumes MealRole opportunities and separately admits RecipeVersion MealTypeCode values through the versioned meal-role compatibility contract. Unsupported MealTypeCode.OTHER is ROLE_UNSUPPORTED rather than fabricated into a role.

COOK_RECIPE requires a RecipeVersion, non-recipe source kinds cannot carry recipe truth, and fixed EAT_OUT events remain user-supplied while Planner-generated remaining events are COOK_RECIPE. Unsupported/non-recipe sources are therefore preserved or rejected, not fabricated as recipe-backed automatic meals.

The immutable source/review commitment machinery is unchanged by DC4 rerun. Exact-head R3-D verification and full backend regression both passed, proving source artifact tamper and process-binding drift remain detectable.

The rerun introduces no Recipe/Food/Nutrition publication of its own. It seeds the accepted production catalogue through the merged A3 publication path, then audits and plans through ordinary services. No synthetic RecipeVersion or gate-only nutrition authority is created.
